s1.where: the start screen with the empty chat and the Ask ChatGPT box
s1.expectation: I think I'm on the main start page where you begin a new chat — the empty one you land on when you open the app.
s1.cue: Nothing at the top names it. I got there from the 'Ask ChatGPT' box at the bottom and the three suggestions above it — 'Start a voice chat', 'Create an image or sticker', 'Write or edit'. The top bar only has the menu lines, a 'Get Plus' button and a round icon.

first_pass.why: The top of the screen is a big empty space with a 'Get Plus' button in it, which is an advert for upgrading, not a place name. I have to read the bottom of the screen to work out where I am, and my eyes go to the blue Get Plus first.
first_pass.solution: Put a short, bold name at the top — 'New chat' or 'Home' — where the Get Plus button is now, and move the upgrade button somewhere quieter.

test_cases.action: Open the app on your phone (if something else is showing, press the round-arrow home/back only as described below). Before tapping anything, say where you are and what told you. Then tap the three-line button at the top left, tap 'Library', come back with the arrow at the top left, and — if the side panel is showing — tap the dimmed area on the right to close it. Say again where you are.
test_cases.real_if: it is real if, both times, nothing on the page lets you name where you are
test_cases.not_real_if: it is not real if something on the page lets you name it
test_cases.what_happened: When I opened the app it didn't go to the first page at all. It opened straight onto the picture page with Trending and Templates. I tapped the X and got a panel headed 'Create an image' over the Ask ChatGPT box, then tapped the X again and finally reached the plain first page. There the top has just the menu lines, the blue 'Get Plus' and a round icon, and underneath are 'Create an image or sticker', 'Write or edit' and 'Ask ChatGPT'. Nothing names the page. I only know it's the start because it's empty and says 'Ask ChatGPT'. For a moment a little floating keyboard toolbar also popped up on the left. Then I opened the menu, tapped Library (which has 'Library' at the top, good) and pressed the back arrow. That put me back in the side menu, not on the page. I tapped the grey area and was back on the same first page, and again nothing on it tells me where I am.

s1.closing_comment: The first page still has no name, and the app didn't even open there. I had to close two picture panels to find it, and the back arrow from Library dropped me in the menu, not on the page. It's harder to hold my place than I thought.

s2.where: a microphone permission pop-up over what looks like a voice chat screen
s2.expectation: I'm in the voice part of the app and it's stopped me with a box asking me to switch on the microphone.
s2.cue: The pop-up text says 'to use Voice', and behind the grey I can see a crossed-out microphone and an X at the bottom. No box, no heading on the screen behind.

first_pass.why: The pop-up tells me what it wants, but the screen underneath has no name at all — just two icons at the top — so I only know it's 'Voice' from one word in the middle of a paragraph. It also warns I'll be sent off to Android settings and have to come back, and that's exactly where I lose track.
first_pass.solution: A bold title on the pop-up like 'Microphone needed for Voice', and a name on the voice screen behind it so when I come back from settings I know I'm in the right place.

test_cases.action: (Not run: the entry that opened that box is no longer on the app's first page, and reaching it another way would mean starting voice, which is not allowed.)
test_cases.reason_not_run: The tester said the way into that microphone box isn't on the first page any more, and reaching it another way would mean starting voice, which I'm not allowed to do.

s2.closing_comment: I couldn't try this one, so my view from the picture stays as it was.

s3.where: the image-making page, on the Trending tab
s3.expectation: I'm in the image creation area, looking at trending picture styles.
s3.cue: The 'Trending' and 'Templates' tabs with Trending shaded, the picture cards with names like 'Sketch' and 'Stickers', and the 'Create image' box at the bottom in blue.

first_pass.why: The shaded 'Trending' tab tells me which bit I'm on and the 'Create image' box confirms it's the image area. There's no big title saying 'Images', but between the tab and the box I got it quickly.

s4.where: the Write or edit suggestions panel
s4.expectation: I'm in the 'Write or edit' part, picking what kind of writing help I want.
s4.cue: The bold 'Write or edit' heading with the X next to it, and the three pencil options under it.

first_pass.why: Short bold heading, three clear choices with the same icon — that's exactly how I like it. It's low on the screen, but it's the only bold thing there so my eye went straight to it.

s5.expectation: I'm on the page for buying the Plus plan.
s5.cue: The huge 'ChatGPT Plus' at the top, and the 'Upgrade for $19.99' button.

first_pass.why: Big name at the top, and the Go/Plus switch below it. I had to double-check which half of the switch was chosen because the grey one is the chosen one, but the big heading answered it for me straight away.

s6.expectation: I'm on the page for the Go plan, the cheaper one.
s6.cue: The big 'ChatGPT Go' heading and 'Upgrade for $8.00'.

first_pass.why: Same as the Plus page — the heading changes with the switch, so I always know which plan I'm looking at.

s7.expectation: I'm in a temporary chat that won't be saved in my history.
s7.cue: 'Temporary chat' in the middle, and the line under it 'This chat won't appear in history', plus 'Temporary chat' again in the typing box.

first_pass.why: It's in the middle of the screen instead of the top, but it's the only words there, so I found it in a second, and it's said twice.

s8.where: the settings panel for a temporary chat
s8.expectation: I've opened the settings for my temporary chat and I'm choosing Personalized or Unpersonalized.
s8.cue: The bold 'Temporary chat settings' heading at the top of the white panel, with 'Temporary chat' still showing faded behind.

first_pass.why: Bold heading on the panel, two choices, one big Done button. Clear and calm.

s9.expectation: I've opened the main side menu of the app.
s9.cue: The list down the left — Images, Library, Projects, Scheduled, Plugins — with the app's name 'ChatGPT' at the top and the rest of the screen greyed out on the right.

first_pass.why: A slide-out list of places is a menu, I don't need a name for that. 'ChatGPT' at the top is just the app name, it doesn't tell me anything, and nothing in the list is highlighted, so it doesn't tell me which place I came from — but I know I'm in the menu.

s10.where: a drawing panel on top of the image page
s10.expectation: I'm in the image area and I've opened some kind of drawing or doodle tool — pencil, shapes, rubber, colours.
s10.cue: The pencil, shapes and eraser buttons, the colour dots along the bottom, and the Trending/Templates tabs still showing above it.

first_pass.why: The panel that takes up most of the screen has no name at all. I'm guessing 'drawing' from the pencil and the colours. The only name-like thing is the Trending tab above, and that's for the page behind, not for this.
first_pass.solution: A short title on the panel like 'Draw' or 'Sketch' so I know what I've opened and why.

test_cases.action: Tap the three-line button, then 'Images', then the flower picture at the top left ('Sketch'). Say where you are. Swipe up once across the big white area. Say where you are now, and whether you are still on the same screen. Then tap the X at the top left of the panel and choose 'Discard' (that only throws away your own lines).
test_cases.real_if: it is real if you cannot say where you are on the panel, or if the swipe takes you somewhere else
test_cases.not_real_if: it is not real if you can name where you are before and after the swipe
test_cases.what_happened: I tapped the Sketch flower card and a white panel came up from the bottom: X, pencil/shapes/rubber, undo, colour dots and a tick. There's no name on the panel. I could see the 'Sketch' card peeking out above it, so I guessed 'the sketch thing'. I swiped up once across the white area and it just drew a black line. I stayed on exactly the same panel, and nothing jumped anywhere or went black. When I pressed the X it asked 'Discard sketch? Your sketch will be lost.' That's the first time the app actually named it. I chose Discard and I was back on the picture page.

s10.closing_comment: The panel itself still has no name, and the app only calls it a 'sketch' when I try to leave. But the Sketch card I tapped stays visible just above it, so I knew what I'd opened.

s11.expectation: I've opened one of the image templates, the underwater portrait one, and it wants a photo from me.
s11.cue: The bold 'See yourself underwater' heading under the photo, and the 'Take photo' / 'Choose photo' buttons.

first_pass.why: The big photo pulls my eye first, but the bold heading is right under it and the two buttons tell me what to do next.

s12.where: the image page with a message stuck over the top
s12.expectation: I'm in the image-making page on Trending — I think the same one as before, but with a back arrow now.
s12.cue: The Trending/Templates tabs and 'Describe an image' at the bottom. At the very top there's a faded message 'Your generated images moved to Library ... from the sidebar' printed right over the clock and the back arrow.

first_pass.why: That message is jammed on top of the back button and the status bar, so the top of the screen is a jumble of overlapping text. My attention went straight to trying to read it and I lost the rest. And there's still no name for the page itself.
first_pass.solution: Show that message as its own clear box I can close, not printed over the back arrow, and give the page a short title like 'Images'.

test_cases.action: Tap the three-line button at the top left, then 'Images'. Before scrolling, say where you are and what told you. Then scroll the pictures down a little, stop, and — without scrolling back — say where you are now.
test_cases.real_if: it is real if, after the small scroll, nothing on screen lets you name the page
test_cases.not_real_if: it is not real if you can still name it from what you see

After a small scroll the tabs and the messy message both slid away. That was actually calmer. Now all I had was the back arrow, the picture cards and the 'Describe an image' box, which stays put at the bottom. I could still say 'image page' because of that box, but only because of that box.

s12.closing_comment: The messy message over the back arrow is really there, but one small scroll clears it away, and the 'Describe an image' box keeps telling me it's the image page. Still no title, but I can manage.
